title: Small Habits, Big Changes
description: A practical way to make progress without waiting for motivation.
description_zh: 不必等待动力，也能持续进步的实用方法。

units.text: Big changes often begin with very small actions.
units.translation: 巨大的改变往往始于非常微小的行动。

units.text: If you want to read more, start with one page before bed each night.
units.translation: 如果你想多读书，可以从每晚睡前读一页开始。

units.text: The action may feel too easy, but that is exactly why you will repeat it.
units.translation: 这个行动可能显得太简单，但正因如此，你才会不断重复。

units.text: After a few weeks, the habit becomes a natural part of your day.
units.translation: 几周以后，这个习惯就会自然地融入你的生活。

units.text: Do not focus on being perfect; focus on showing up again tomorrow.
units.translation: 不要执着于做到完美，而要专注于明天继续行动。
